updates.title: CVE-2026-97785: AAD App Proxy Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A flaw in Azure AD Application Proxy allows unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges over the network due to improper authentication controls. Admins should prioritize patching this vulnerability to prevent unauthorized access to proxied applications.

updates.title: CVE-2026-80092: Microsoft Identity Web Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Microsoft Identity Web (versions 3 and 4) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability requiring patching. Organizations using Identity Web for authentication should update to the fixed versions (3.16.0 or 4.16.1) to protect against unauthorized privilege escalation.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: FTP and SFTP Transfer Monitoring (General Availability)
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP now generally supports monitoring and enforcing policies on sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols. Admins can configure these transfer activities in Endpoint DLP policies to extend data protection beyond traditional web and email channels.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Global Secure Access Integration (General Availability)
updates.summary: Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce data protection policies at the network layer, preventing sensitive data exfiltration to untrusted cloud apps and AI platforms. This enables comprehensive protection across browsers, APIs, and add-ins.

updates.title: Information Barriers: Policy Compliance Report (New)
updates.summary: A new compliance report feature helps admins identify SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that fall out of compliance after Information Barriers policy changes. This aids in detecting and remediating policy violations across the organization.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Decoupled Policy Tips and Email Notifications (Launched)
updates.summary: DLP admins can now independently configure policy tips and email notifications for SharePoint and OneDrive, rather than requiring both or neither. This flexibility allows tailored enforcement strategies per rule and improves control over user notifications.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Alert Classification (In Development)
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management will introduce granular alert classification—True Positive, Benign (Operational), or False Positive—with predefined reasoning categories for authorized analysts. This replaces existing dismissal reasons and improves alert tuning and regulatory reporting.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience (In Development)
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is consolidating all classifiers—Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint classifiers, and trainable classifiers—into a single interface for discovery, creation, validation, and management. This streamlines the management experience and reduces administrative overhead.

updates.title: Information Protection: Auto-labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report (Rolling Out)
updates.summary: Admins can now view per-policy coverage reports showing which files were labeled or remain unlabeled during auto-labeling policy enforcement compared to the latest simulation snapshot. This visibility helps track enforcement progress and identify data gaps.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Adaptive Protection Integration (In Development)
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management will integrate with Adaptive Protection to automatically apply retention labels to emails and files based on dynamic insider risk levels. This enables dynamic data preservation aligned with user risk profiles.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes (In Development)
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary) will be accessible through Microsoft Graph API, providing unified access across distributed archive data as EWS APIs deprecate. This simplifies compliance operations managing large-scale mailbox archives.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Azure PST Import (In Development)
updates.summary: Azure PST Import enables direct migration of PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using a two-step validation and execution pattern. This modernizes PST migration workflows for hybrid and cloud-native environments.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Hard Delete for OneDrive and SharePoint (In Development)
updates.summary: A new hard delete capability through secure priority cleanup workflows will allow admins to permanently remove content from OneDrive and SharePoint while mitigating data loss risks through governance controls. This enables faster compliance-driven content removal.
